title: Ladies Kingdom
synopsis: Have you heard of the “Ladies Kingdom” in Yunnan where everything is decided by women?

fullText.simplified:
女儿国

    在中国云南省，有一个叫摩梭族的民族。这个民族被人们称作“女儿国”，因为那里的一切都由女性决定。
    摩梭族的男女一般不结婚，也不住在一起。一到晚上，男方会用特殊的暗号敲开女方的房门，住在女方家。到了早上，男方会回到自己的家中生活、劳动。如果有一方不喜欢对方了，可以随时结束关系。要么是男方不敲女方的房门了，要么是女方不开门给男方了。
    如果女方生下孩子，孩子由女方养。等孩子满月的时候，生父会举办宴席，告诉大家这是自己的孩子。其他时候，生父不和孩子住在一起，也没有养孩子的责任。
    这样的“女儿国”，你喜欢吗？
fullText.traditional:
女兒國

    在中國雲南省，有一個叫摩梭族的民族。這個民族被人們稱作“女兒國”，因為那裡的一切都由女性決定。
    摩梭族的男女一般不結婚，也不住在一起。一到晚上，男方會用特殊的暗號敲開女方的房門，住在女方家。到了早上，男方會回到自己的家中生活、勞動。如果有一方不喜歡對方了，可以隨時結束關係。要麼是男方不敲女方的房門了，要麼是女方不開門給男方了。
    如果女方生下孩子，孩子由女方養。等孩子滿月的時候，生父會舉辦宴席，告訴大家這是自己的孩子。其他時候，生父不和孩子住在一起，也沒有養孩子的責任。
    這樣的“女兒國”，你喜歡嗎？

sentences.traditional: 在中國雲南省，有一個叫摩梭族的民族。

sentences.simplified: 这个民族被人们称作“女儿国”，因为那里的一切都由女性决定。
sentences.traditional: 這個民族被人們稱作“女兒國”，因為那裡的一切都由女性決定。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge mín zú bèi rén men chēng zuò nǚ ér guó yīn wèi nà lǐ de yí qiè dōu yóu nǚ xìng jué dìng
sentences.english: In the Yunnan province in China, there is an ethnic group called Mosuo.
This ethnic group is commonly called “Ladies Kingdom”, because everything there is decided by women.

sentences.simplified: 摩梭族的男女一般不结婚，也不住在一起。
sentences.traditional: 摩梭族的男女一般不結婚，也不住在一起。
sentences.pinyin: mó suō zú de nán nǚ yì bān bù jié hūn yě bú zhù zài yì qǐ

sentences.simplified: 一到晚上，男方会用特殊的暗号敲开女方的房门，住在女方家。
sentences.traditional: 一到晚上，男方會用特殊的暗號敲開女方的房門，住在女方家。
sentences.pinyin: yí dào wǎn shang nán fāng huì yòng tè shū de àn hào qiāo kāi nǚ fāng de fáng mén zhù zài nǚ fāng jiā
sentences.english: Mosuo's men and women usually do not marry, and do not live together either.

sentences.simplified: 到了早上，男方会回到自己的家中生活、劳动。
sentences.traditional: 到了早上，男方會回到自己的家中生活、勞動。
sentences.pinyin: dào le zǎo shang nán fāng huì huí dào zì jǐ de jiā zhōng shēng huó láo dòng
sentences.english: When the night arrives, the man will use a special code to knock on the woman's door, and stay at her house.

sentences.simplified: 如果有一方不喜欢对方了，可以随时结束关系。
sentences.traditional: 如果有一方不喜歡對方了，可以隨時結束關係。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yǒu yì fāng bù xǐ huan duì fāng le kě yǐ suí shí jié shù guān xi
sentences.english: In the morning, the man will return to his own home to live and work.

sentences.simplified: 要么是男方不敲女方的房门了，要么是女方不开门给男方了。
sentences.traditional: 要麼是男方不敲女方的房門了，要麼是女方不開門給男方了。
sentences.pinyin: yào me shì nán fāng bù qiāo nǚ fāng de fáng mén le yào me shì nǚ fāng bù kāi mén gěi nán fāng le
sentences.english: If one side doesn't like the other side anymore, they can end the relationship at any time.
If it's the man he can stop knocking the woman's door; if it's the woman she can stop opening the door.

sentences.simplified: 如果女方生下孩子，孩子由女方养。
sentences.traditional: 如果女方生下孩子，孩子由女方養。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǚ fāng shēng xià hái zi hái zi yóu nǚ fāng yǎng

sentences.simplified: 等孩子满月的时候，生父会举办宴席，告诉大家这是自己的孩子。
sentences.traditional: 等孩子滿月的時候，生父會舉辦宴席，告訴大家這是自己的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: děng hái zi mǎn yuè de shí hou shēng fù huì jǔ bàn yàn xí gào su dà jiā zhè shì zì jǐ de hái zi
sentences.english: If the woman has a child, the child will be raised by the woman.

sentences.simplified: 其他时候，生父不和孩子住在一起，也没有养孩子的责任。
sentences.traditional: 其他時候，生父不和孩子住在一起，也沒有養孩子的責任。
sentences.pinyin: qí tā shí hou shēng fù bù hé hái zi zhù zài yì qǐ yě méi yǒu yǎng hái zi de zé rèn
sentences.english: When the child turns one month, the father will hold a banquet to announce to everyone that it is his child.
At all other times, the father does not live together with the child, and has no responsibility to raise the child.

sentences.simplified: 这样的“女儿国”，你喜欢吗？
sentences.traditional: 這樣的“女兒國”，你喜歡嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de nǚ ér guó nǐ xǐ huan ma

sentences.english: Do you like this kind of “Ladies Kingdom”?

raw.synopsis: Have you heard of the “Ladies Kingdom” in Yunnan where everything is decided by women?
sentence_translations: In the Yunnan province in China, there is an ethnic group called Mosuo.
This ethnic group is commonly called “Ladies Kingdom”, because everything there is decided by women.
Mosuo's men and women usually do not marry, and do not live together either.
When the night arrives, the man will use a special code to knock on the woman's door, and stay at her house.
In the morning, the man will return to his own home to live and work.
If one side doesn't like the other side anymore, they can end the relationship at any time.
If it's the man he can stop knocking the woman's door; if it's the woman she can stop opening the door.
If the woman has a child, the child will be raised by the woman.
When the child turns one month, the father will hold a banquet to announce to everyone that it is his child.
At all other times, the father does not live together with the child, and has no responsibility to raise the child.
Do you like this kind of “Ladies Kingdom”?
